fact.observer: HEALTH_GUARD; HOST_PLATFORM independently observes guard and expected journal
fact.credential: Native writer generation/purpose key, no participant co-holder
fact.CAS_expected: Exact current verified journal tip/sequence AND entity key/revision/predecessor AND current generation high-water AND legal state edge; duplicate operation key never resets logical entity
fact.CAS_next: Append journal_sequence+1/entity_revision+1 checked; update derived entity index only after fsync and independent witness; generation ledger increments only on authorized new generation, work publication never changes generation revision
fact.monotonicity: No decreasing high-water/revision or deleted tombstone; incomplete/corrupt/unavailable latest row is UNKNOWN, never earlier generation fallback
fact.one_use: Each challenge/work_id consumes at most one exact generation input/result/publication; duplicate same bytes returns original receipt, no work; conflicting bytes denies
fact.replacement: Old enrollment revoked, pending UNKNOWN reconciled, old endpoint extinction independently proved, irreversible tombstone durable, checked new generation previous+1 before new enrollment
fact.restart: Retain original pending/current high-water and tombstones; new process instance cannot adopt old enrollment/key/work; unclear continuity requires new isolated incarnation under separate trusted provisioning
fact.reconnect: Retire old channel identity, preserve pending UNKNOWN; no new channel enrollment or work while unresolved
fact.revocation: Monotonic invalidation before new eligibility; every old receipt/credential/channel remains ineligible
fact.tombstone: Retired slot/generation remains irreversible even if newer process dies or registry lookup fails
fact.stale_generation: Any supplied generation != independently current high-water/current entity denies; never search older signed rows as fallback
fact.publication_receipt: Writer signature + exact record/journal/entity digest and revision + independent HEALTH_GUARD observed tip receipt, full R5N context

CONSUMPTION hashes prior artifact+observation and exact one-use CAS. Only then COMPLETED_WORK hashes role result record containing those prior receipt digests. No result hashes its own final receipt or depends on a later DAG node

Only HEALTH_GUARD submits fixed validated record schemas to native writer. ARTIFACT must carry producer evidence; OBSERVATION requires distinct current consumer/census/guard witness as appropriate; CONSUMPTION only consumer + exact artifact one-use CAS; COMPLETED_WORK only after role-specific independent observation. Purpose is derived from fixed stage/message route, never arbitrary module operation selector

Record work_id=SHA256(u32be domain byte length || exact ASCII FLOOOW/PACKAGE0090/R5N/WORK-ID/{purpose}/V1 || bootstrap_context_digest32 || related_subject_work_id32 || challenge_id32). purpose is exact uppercase ASCII enum name ARTIFACT/OBSERVATION/CONSUMPTION/COMPLETED_WORK, never numeric/string-coerced. related_subject_work_id MUST equal the base_subject_work_id of the observed subject; record publication_purpose u16be MUST match that purpose enum. Recompute and reject mismatch; no caller-chosen hashing/type order

ARTIFACT must carry producer evidence; OBSERVATION requires distinct current consumer/census/guard witness as appropriate; CONSUMPTION only consumer + exact artifact one-use CAS; COMPLETED_WORK only after role-specific independent observation. Same bytes yield original receipt only, conflicting bytes reject, no renewed work/clock/revision or double consumption.
